components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action button. Blue background, white text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #3b82f6; color: #ffffff; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border-radius: 0.75rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #60a5fa; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3b82f6; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary action. Elevated surface background with border.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #1c1c20; color: #e4e4e7; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border-radius: 0.75rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid #3f3f46; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #27272a; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3f3f46; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #71717a; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border-radius: 0.75rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: all 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(39, 39, 42, 0.5); color: #e4e4e7; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3f3f46; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Active Filter Chip
components.description: Selected filter state. Blue tint background.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; padding: 0.125rem 0.5rem; border-radius: 0.375rem; border: 1px solid transparent; transition: all 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip-active { background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.12); color: #60a5fa; border-color: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.2); } .ds-chip-active:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3b82f6; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Inactive Filter Chip
components.css: .ds-chip-inactive { background: #1c1c20; color: #71717a; border-color: #3f3f46; } .ds-chip-inactive:hover { background: #27272a; color: #a1a1aa; } .ds-chip-inactive:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3f3f46; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: A personal knowledge browser that feels like opening a well-organized desk drawer, not launching a SaaS product. Dark surfaces provide comfortable reading in any lighting. One accent carries intent. Two semantic colors carry category meaning. Everything else gets out of the way. The system is deliberately restrained, Obsidian-sharp in its efficiency and Notion-warm in its readability. It rejects the modern dark mode aesthetic of blurred glass, gradient text, and hero metrics.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained color: one accent (blue) + two semantic colors (emerald for folders/content, purple for calendar)
Solid surfaces: opaque backgrounds, no backdrop blur or glass sheen
Weight-based hierarchy: bold for headings, regular for body, no gradient text anywhere
Consistent vocabulary: filter chips, active states, and navigation follow one pattern across all pages
High contrast body text: zinc-200 on zinc-950, not gray-400

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Blue (#3b82f6) is the single interaction accent. It marks active states, primary actions, and focus rings. Its rarity is the point. If blue appears, something is clickable, selected, or current.

rules.name: The No Decoration Rule
rules.body: Emerald and purple encode category meaning (folder vs calendar). They never appear as background gradients, text gradients, or glow effects. Badge backgrounds use 12% opacity fills, not full saturation.

rules.name: The Weight Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Title (700) → Heading (600) → Body (400) → Label (500). Each step has a weight change of ≥100. Never use gradient text, color transitions, or text-shadow to create hierarchy.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Cards are flat at rest. Elevation is communicated through brightness steps and border color, never through shadow, blur, or transparent layering.

dos: Use solid opaque surfaces for all cards and containers
Use Workspace Blue (#3b82f6) exclusively for interactive accent
Create hierarchy through font weight and size contrast, not color gradients
Ensure all body text meets WCAG AAA contrast (zinc-200 on zinc-950)
Use the same filter chip pattern everywhere
Add skip-to-content links and aria-current on active navigation
Add focus-visible outlines on all interactive elements
donts: Use backdrop-filter: blur(), ::before sheen gradients, or semi-transparent card backgrounds
Use background-clip: text with gradients on any text element
Use border-left or border-right wider than 1px as colored accent stripes
Use hero-metric layouts (large number + small label + gradient/glow accent)
Use decorative glow on logos, icons, or active elements
Use more than three semantic colors for meaningful encoding
Use different active-state styles for the same interaction across pages
Use #000 or #fff — tint every neutral toward the workspace palette
